1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time interval, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, __wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from and more prominent than the first alarm__.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track escalation states of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __and escalation state information__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data __including the escalation state information__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system __and wherein the processor is programmed to manage alarm escalation across both the physiological monitor and the central management system__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises __detailed__ information about a level of escalation of the alarm __including timestamps for each escalation event__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm __and the identity of the operator who acknowledged the alarm__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __only when the alarm has not been acknowledged at the physiological monitor or central station within a specified time period__.
